Lemma
[Convexity of the pinching cone] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0271, chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0272 1. Lemma 9.5\group positive-section-dominates

At each fixed time $t$, the subset $\mathcal K$ of curvature operators defined by the inequalities \[ r \mathbb P\ge -3(1+t),\qquad r \mathbb P\ge | u (\mathbb P)| igl(\log | u (\mathbb P)|+\log (1+t)-3 igr) \] whenever $ u (\mathbb P)\le -1/(1+t)$, is invariant under parallel translation and convex in each fiber.
